content.text:
Submitted (final). Deviation on §§ 21.1 and 21.3, cured at the preferred level with two surgical replaces:

1. **§ 21.1** — "Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's aggregate liability shall not exceed the greater of Fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000." Replaces the one-month, "without exception" cap so the § 21.3 Excluded Claims (confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnities, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) are genuinely uncapped.
2. **§ 21.3 final sentence** — "Customer's payment obligations for undisputed amounts due under this Agreement, including Fees, taxes, expenses and interest, are not damages and are not limited by this Section." This now reaches Customer's payment obligations as a whole (defined "Fees" omits taxes, expenses, interest and implementation charges) while retaining the Customer-favourable "undisputed" qualifier.

§ 21.2's mutual indirect/consequential exclusion and direct-damages sentence, and the Excluded Claims list itself, are preserved verbatim; no ancillary or non-element terms were added.
